teaser: A toast finishes and laughter moves around the table like it was always going to. You are a life path 3, reached through the compound number 30 — the number your birth date adds up to before it is reduced to a single digit — paired with an INTJ who checks the joke twice before it leaves your mouth. The 3 asks for a voice that spills easily; the INTJ in you drafts the overflow into something load-bearing first. What is particular to this crossing is a performer who edits in the wings, charming on a timer, bright once the structure underneath has been checked and found sound.
